On Thu, Apr 11, 2028 at 9:18 AM, priyom_das@redwood.ai wrote:
> Marissa / Vivek — forwarding PayStream's alert. This is high-severity...

Quick ops readout: we've confirmed a saturation pattern on the PayStream dedicated GPU pool. Summary:
- Observed: sustained token queue depth increase from 40 -> 240 (median queue depth across pool).
- Latency: median per-token latency jumped 3.9x for sequences > 512 tokens.
- Errors: 5xx surge maps to OOM/rejected-execution on 2 nodes and request timeouts behind the load balancer.
- KV cache: miss-rate jumped ~60% likely due to model routing variance from a new canary variant earlier this morning.

Immediate mitigations we can apply in the next 20-30 minutes:
1) Disable the canary variant routing for PayStream (roll back routing override) — low risk, quick.
2) Deprioritize non-critical inference routes (internal batch jobs) — we can reduce background work by 30% today.
3) Temporarily route a small % of traffic to hosted baseline model (lower-cost but more headroom).

Longer actions (requires approval):
- Provision burst capacity (+2 nodes) — needs sales ops approval for cost/credit and 30–45m to warm up.

I'll attach pool_metrics_0411.png for the exec deck. Ops is standing by to implement 1+2 immediately once we have green light.

-Marissa
Sr. Product Manager, Service Reliability — Redwood Inference
